entries.title: Job 37:1
segments: ¶Aye, my heart trembleth at this also, and leapeth up out of its place:

entries.title: Job 37:2
segments: Hear attentively the roar of his voice, and the murmur going forth from his mouth.

entries.title: Job 37:3
segments: He sendeth it forth under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.

entries.title: Job 37:4
segments: After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency, and holdeth not back the flashes when his voice is heard.

entries.title: Job 37:5
segments: *God thundereth marvellously with his voice, doing great things which we do not comprehend.

entries.title: Job 37:6
segments: ¶For he saith to the snow, Fall on the earth! and to the pouring rain, even the pouring rains of his might.

entries.title: Job 37:7
segments: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.

entries.title: Job 37:8
segments: And the wild beast goeth into its lair, and they remain in their dens.

entries.title: Job 37:9
segments: From the chamber [of the south] cometh the whirlwind; and cold from the winds of the north.

entries.title: Job 37:10
segments: By the breath of *God ice is given; and the breadth of the waters is straitened.

entries.title: Job 37:11
segments: Also with plentiful moisture he loadeth the thick clouds, his light dispels the cloud;

entries.title: Job 37:12
segments: And they are turned every way by his guidance, that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the circuit of the earth,

entries.title: Job 37:13
segments: Whether he cause it to come as a rod, or for his land, or in mercy.

entries.title: Job 37:14
segments: ¶Hearken unto this, Job; stand still and discern the wondrous works of *God.

entries.title: Job 37:15
segments: Dost thou know how +God hath disposed them, and how he causeth the lightning of his cloud to flash?

entries.title: Job 37:16
segments: Dost thou know about the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him that is perfect in knowledge?

entries.title: Job 37:17
segments: How thy garments become warm when he quieteth the earth by the south wind?

entries.title: Job 37:18
segments: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, firm, like a molten mirror?

entries.title: Job 37:19
segments: Teach us what we shall say unto him! We cannot order [our words] by reason of darkness.

entries.title: Job 37:20
segments: Shall it be told him if I would speak? if a man [so] say, surely he shall be swallowed up.

entries.title: Job 37:21
segments: ¶And now [men] see not the light as it gleameth, it is [hidden] in the skies. But the wind passeth by and cleareth them.

entries.title: Job 37:22
segments: From the north cometh gold; with +God is terrible majesty.

entries.title: Job 37:23
segments: The Almighty, we cannot find him out: excellent in power, and in judgment, and in abundance of justice, he doth not afflict.

entries.title: Job 37:24
segments: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.
